==============================================================================
host-vscode/esbuild.mjs
==============================================================================
// Bundles each diagram webview in `src/webview/` into `out/webview/`, its
// stylesheet beside it: once, or on every change with `--watch`. The extension
// itself is `tsc`'s, since the extension host loads it with its `node_modules`.
//
// At `platform: 'browser'` esbuild refuses a `node:*` import rather than
// shimming it, so a Node import reaching a webview fails here rather than in
// the webview's own console.

import { context } from 'esbuild';
import { readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('.', import.meta.url));

const build = await context({
   absWorkingDir: root,
   entryPoints: readdirSync(new URL('src/webview/', import.meta.url))
      .filter(file => file.endsWith('.ts'))
      .map(file => `src/webview/${file}`),
   outdir: 'out/webview',
   bundle: true,
   platform: 'browser',
   // The editor loads the bundle with a plain `<script>`.
   format: 'iife',
   target: 'es2022',
   sourcemap: true,
   // The icon font GLSP imports, inlined: a webview loads only the URIs the
   // extension mints at runtime, which a bundled `url()` cannot name.
   loader: { '.ttf': 'dataurl' },
   logLevel: 'info'
});

if (process.argv.includes('--watch')) {
   await build.watch();
} else {
   await build.rebuild();
   await build.dispose();
}

==============================================================================
host-vscode/src/webview/diagram.css
==============================================================================
/* The diagram webviews' size and colours, bundled after GLSP's stylesheet so
   these rules win on equal specificity. */

/* A webview has no layout above the document, so each element down to the
   SVG needs a height, or the diagram draws at zero height. */
html,
body {
   height: 100%;
   width: 100%;
   margin: 0;
   padding: 0;
   overflow: hidden;
}

.hydranium-diagram-container,
.hydranium-diagram-container > .sprotty,
.hydranium-diagram-container > .sprotty > svg {
   height: 100%;
   width: 100%;
   display: block;
}

/* The editor's theme, rather than GLSP's colours for a light canvas. */
.sprotty {
   background: var(--vscode-editor-background);
   color: var(--vscode-editor-foreground);
   font-family: var(--vscode-font-family);
   font-size: var(--vscode-font-size);
}

/* GLSP's stylesheet leaves shapes at the SVG defaults: a black fill, and no stroke on an edge. */
.sprotty-node {
   fill: var(--vscode-editorWidget-background);
   stroke: var(--vscode-focusBorder);
}

.sprotty-edge {
   fill: none;
   stroke: var(--vscode-editor-foreground);
}

// The Bookstore diagram's custom editor: a webview over the diagram bundle
// esbuild writes to `out/webview/`.

import { HydraniumGlspEditorProvider } from '@hydranium/glsp-client-vscode/node';
import { BOOKSTORE_DIAGRAM_TYPE } from 'bookstore-protocol';

/**
 * The view type `contributes.customEditors` in `package.json` declares. VS Code
 * reads the manifest statically, so the two are kept equal by hand, and a
 * mismatch leaves the file with no diagram editor.
 */
export const BOOKSTORE_DIAGRAM_VIEW_TYPE = 'bookstore.diagram';

export class BookstoreDiagramEditorProvider extends HydraniumGlspEditorProvider {
   override diagramType = BOOKSTORE_DIAGRAM_TYPE;
   protected override readonly scriptPath = 'out/webview/bookstore-diagram.js';
   protected override readonly stylePath = 'out/webview/bookstore-diagram.css';
   protected override readonly title = 'Bookstore Diagram';
}

// The Bookstore diagram webview: GLSP's handshake with the extension host,
// over the diagram the client package defines. Never import this from the
// extension: its graph reaches stylesheets, which Node cannot load.

import type { ContainerConfiguration } from '@eclipse-glsp/client';
import { HydraniumGlspStarter } from '@hydranium/glsp-client-vscode/browser';
import { Container } from 'inversify';
import { initializeBookstoreDiagramContainer } from 'bookstore-client';
// Last, so its rules follow GLSP's stylesheet in the bundle.
import './diagram.css';

class BookstoreDiagramStarter extends HydraniumGlspStarter {
   createContainer(...containerConfiguration: ContainerConfiguration): Container {
      return initializeBookstoreDiagramContainer(new Container(), ...containerConfiguration);
   }
}

new BookstoreDiagramStarter();

host-vscode/test/smoke.spec.mts
==============================================================================
// VS Code opens a copy of the starter workspace with this extension loaded, the
// data head reads the file, the diagram file draws in its diagram editor, and
// the server reports a reference that resolves to nothing.

import { _electron, expect, test, type ElectronApplication, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { downloadAndUnzipVSCode } from '@vscode/test-electron';
import { cpSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { VSCODE_CACHE, VSCODE_VERSION } from './vscode-version.mts';

const extensionRoot = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));

test('reads the model, draws the diagram, and reports a broken reference', async () => {
   // A copy, since the server writes its repairs to the folder it opens, and a
   // fresh profile, since a reused one restores the last run's editors.
   const scratch = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'bookstore-vscode-'));
   const workspace = join(scratch, 'workspace');
   cpSync(fileURLToPath(new URL('../../workspace', import.meta.url)), workspace, { recursive: true });
   let app: ElectronApplication | undefined;
   try {
      app = await _electron.launch({
         executablePath: await downloadAndUnzipVSCode({ version: VSCODE_VERSION, cachePath: VSCODE_CACHE }),
         args: [
            '--no-sandbox',
            '--disable-gpu-sandbox',
            '--disable-updates',
            '--skip-welcome',
            '--skip-release-notes',
            '--disable-workspace-trust',
            '--disable-extensions',
            `--extensionDevelopmentPath=${extensionRoot}`,
            `--user-data-dir=${join(scratch, 'user-data')}`,
            `--extensions-dir=${join(scratch, 'extensions')}`,
            workspace
         ]
      });
      const page = await app.firstWindow();
      await expect(page.locator('.monaco-workbench')).toBeVisible();
      await quickOpen(page, 'nodes.bookstore');
      // The data head reads the open file.
      await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+Shift+P');
      await page.locator('.quick-input-widget input').fill('>Bookstore: Show Model');
      await page
         .locator('.quick-input-list')
         .getByRole('option', { name: /^Bookstore: Show Model(,|$)/ })
         .click();
      await expect(page.locator('.notification-toast').filter({ hasText: 'nodes.bookstore holds a BookstoreModel' })).toBeVisible();

      // The diagram file opens in its diagram, which draws the two starter nodes.
      const webview = page.frameLocator('iframe.webview.ready').frameLocator('#active-frame');
      // In the editor's container: sprotty measures shapes in a hidden copy beside it.
      await expect(webview.locator('.hydranium-diagram-container .sprotty-node')).toHaveCount(2);
      // Then as text. The row is clicked, since Enter runs the best fuzzy match,
      // and its name ends in its keybinding, if it has one.
      await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+Shift+P');
      await page.locator('.quick-input-widget input').fill('>View: Reopen Editor with Text Editor');
      await page
         .locator('.quick-input-list')
         .getByRole('option', { name: /^View: Reopen Editor with Text Editor(,|$)/ })
         .click();

      const editor = page.locator('.monaco-editor .view-lines').first();
      await expect(editor).toContainText('node First');
      await editor.click();
      await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+End');
      // In one edit: typed key by key, the half-typed reference is reported on the way.
      await page.keyboard.insertText('\nnode Broken -> Missing');
      await expect(page.locator('.monaco-editor .squiggly-error').first()).toBeVisible();
   } finally {
      await app?.close();
      rmSync(scratch, { recursive: true, force: true });
   }
});

/** Open `file` through Quick Open, so it gets the editor a user would. */
async function quickOpen(page: Page, file: string): Promise<void> {
   await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+P');
   const input = page.locator('.quick-input-widget input');
   await input.fill(file);
   await expect(page.locator('.quick-input-list .monaco-list-row').first()).toContainText(file);
   await input.press('Enter');
   await expect(page.locator('.quick-input-widget')).toBeHidden();
}

import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

/**
 * The VS Code build the smoke test downloads and runs. Pinned rather than
 * `stable`, so a VS Code release cannot fail a run with no change here.
 */
export const VSCODE_VERSION = '1.141.0';

/** Where `@vscode/test-electron` keeps the download, below this package. */
export const VSCODE_CACHE = fileURLToPath(new URL('../.vscode-test', import.meta.url));

==============================================================================
host-vscode/test/install-vscode.mts
==============================================================================
// Downloads the pinned VS Code into `.vscode-test/`, retrying, so the smoke
// test finds it there and asks the update server nothing.

import { downloadAndUnzipVSCode } from '@vscode/test-electron';
import { setTimeout } from 'node:timers/promises';
import { VSCODE_CACHE, VSCODE_VERSION } from './vscode-version.mts';

const ATTEMPTS = 3;

for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
   try {
      await downloadAndUnzipVSCode({ version: VSCODE_VERSION, cachePath: VSCODE_CACHE });
      break;
   } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (attempt === ATTEMPTS) {
         throw error;
      }
      console.warn(`Downloading VS Code ${VSCODE_VERSION} failed, attempt ${attempt} of ${ATTEMPTS}.`, error);
      await setTimeout(attempt * 5_000);
   }
}

==============================================================================
host-theia-browser/README.md
==============================================================================
# bookstore-host-theia-browser

Bookstore in a Theia browser application: the Theia extension in `../theia`, and
`../vscode-servers` sideloaded through `@theia/plugin-ext`, which starts the
server and its language client. The backend runs the server, so this is a Node
application; Theia serves the page. The servers extension contributes no editor,
so a diagram file opens in the Theia diagram editor alone.

```bash
npm run build              # bundle and type-check; build the members first
npm run watch              # rebundle whenever the members’ builds change; reload the page to pick it up
npm start                  # Theia at http://localhost:3000 on ../workspace; THEIA_PORT picks another port
npm run test:e2e:install   # download the Chromium the smoke test drives, once
npm run test:e2e           # the smoke test, which starts the application itself
```

The `theia` block of `package.json` sets `frontendConnectionTimeout`, without
which Theia ends the session on any dropped socket and the page reloads, and
`connectionBufferBytes`, the messages kept while the socket is down; the Theia
extension’s connection modules read both.

## Layout

- `esbuild.mjs` — the bundling `theia build` runs. It keeps this file, so it is the place to adjust the bundle
- `start.mjs` — `npm start`: links `../vscode-servers` into `plugins/`, then starts the backend on `THEIA_PORT`, on a folder given as its argument or `../workspace`
- `playwright.config.mts` — the smoke tier, on port 4938 or `THEIA_PORT`, on a copy of `../workspace` in `smoke-workspace/`
- `test/smoke.spec.mts` — Theia opens the workspace and each head answers

==============================================================================
host-theia-browser/esbuild.mjs
==============================================================================
/**
 * This file can be edited to adjust the ESBuild build process.
 * To reset, delete this file and rerun theia build again.
 */
import { browserOptions, watch } from './gen-esbuild.browser.mjs';
import { nodeOptions } from './gen-esbuild.node.mjs';

import esbuild from 'esbuild';

const browserContext = await esbuild.context(browserOptions);
const nodeContext = await esbuild.context(nodeOptions);

if (watch) {
   await Promise.all([browserContext.watch(), nodeContext.watch()]);
} else {
   try {
      await browserContext.rebuild();
      await browserContext.dispose();
      await nodeContext.rebuild();
      await nodeContext.dispose();
   } catch {
      process.exit(1);
   }
}

==============================================================================
host-theia-browser/start.mjs
==============================================================================
// `npm start`: the Theia backend on `THEIA_PORT`, 3000 when it is unset, on the
// folder given as the argument, `../workspace` when there is none. A script
// rather than `--port=${THEIA_PORT:-3000}` in package.json: only a POSIX shell
// expands that, and npm also runs scripts under cmd.exe.

import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

// Paths from this file, not the working directory, which a direct `node` run can set anywhere.
const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const link = path.join(here, 'plugins', 'bookstore-vscode-servers');

// The servers extension, sideloaded from plugins/ beside any other plugin there.
// Linked here rather than in the build, which a build cache can replay without
// it; replaced every time, since a dangling link left by a moved extension
// fails `symlinkSync`.
fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(link), { recursive: true });
const existing = fs.lstatSync(link, { throwIfNoEntry: false });
// A link, a junction included, is unlinked, never handed to a recursive remove
// that might reach `../vscode-servers` through it.
if (existing?.isSymbolicLink()) {
   fs.unlinkSync(link);
} else {
   fs.rmSync(link, { recursive: true, force: true });
}
fs.symlinkSync(path.join(here, '../vscode-servers'), link, 'junction');

const port = Number(process.env.THEIA_PORT || 3000);
const workspace = path.resolve(process.argv[2] ?? path.join(here, '../workspace'));
// The CLI run by this Node, with no shell: the workspace path reaches Theia as it is.
// `local-dir:` relative to `cwd`, since Theia reads an absolute path as a URI.
const cli = createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve('@theia/cli/bin/theia.js');
const theia = spawn(process.execPath, [cli, 'start', '--plugins=local-dir:./plugins', `--port=${port}`, workspace], {
   cwd: here,
   stdio: 'inherit'
});
for (const signal of ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM']) {
   process.on(signal, () => theia.kill(signal));
}
theia.on('exit', (code, signal) => {
   if (signal === null) {
      process.exit(code ?? 1);
   }
   // Ended by a signal, so end by it too: Ctrl+C is a stop, not a failure.
   process.removeAllListeners(signal);
   process.kill(process.pid, signal);
});

==============================================================================
host-theia-browser/playwright.config.mts
==============================================================================
// The smoke tier: Playwright starts the application on a copy of the starter
// workspace, since the server writes its repairs to the folder it opens, and
// drives it in Chromium, which `npm run test:e2e:install` downloads once.
// `npm start` serves what `npm run build` bundled, so build first.

import { defineConfig, devices } from '@playwright/test';
import { cpSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';

/**
 * The port the smoke serves on, not `npm start`'s 3000, so a running
 * application doesn't block it; set `THEIA_PORT` to choose another.
 */
const PORT = Number(process.env.THEIA_PORT || 4938);

// Copied once, by the runner: its workers load this file again, and inherit the flag.
if (process.env.SMOKE_WORKSPACE_COPIED === undefined) {
   process.env.SMOKE_WORKSPACE_COPIED = 'true';
   const workspace = new URL('smoke-workspace', import.meta.url);
   rmSync(workspace, { recursive: true, force: true });
   cpSync(new URL('../workspace', import.meta.url), workspace, { recursive: true });
   // Settings of its own too, so a run never writes `~/.theia/settings.json`.
   process.env.THEIA_CONFIG_DIR ??= mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'theia-smoke-config-'));
}

export default defineConfig({
   testDir: './test',
   // The first request waits for the backend to start the server and build the workspace.
   timeout: 120_000,
   expect: { timeout: 60_000 },
   use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'], baseURL: `http://localhost:${PORT}` },
   webServer: {
      // Relative to this folder, the server's working directory.
      command: 'node start.mjs smoke-workspace',
      url: `http://localhost:${PORT}`,
      env: { THEIA_PORT: String(PORT) },
      // A server already on the port fails the run rather than being tested in this one's place.
      reuseExistingServer: false,
      timeout: 120_000
   }
});

// The smoke tier, which runs in Node under Playwright. `test:e2e` passes it

{
  "compilerOptions": {

    "lib": ["ES2022", "DOM"],
    "module": "NodeNext",
    "moduleResolution": "NodeNext",
    "strict": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "noEmit": true,
    "types": ["node"]
  },
  "include": ["test", "playwright.config.mts"]
}

host-theia-browser/test/smoke.spec.mts
==============================================================================
// Theia opens a copy of the starter workspace with this application's
// extensions, the diagram file draws in its diagram editor, the data head reads
// the file, and the server reports a reference that resolves to nothing.

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

test('draws the diagram, reads the model, and reports a broken reference', async ({ page }) => {
   await page.goto('/');
   // Up once the loading screen is gone; a key pressed before then is lost.
   await expect(page.locator('.theia-preload')).toHaveCount(0);
   await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+Shift+E');
   await expect(page.locator('.theia-FileTree .theia-TreeNode', { hasText: 'nodes.bookstore' })).toBeVisible();
   await quickOpen(page, 'nodes.bookstore');

   // The diagram file opens in its diagram, which draws the two starter nodes.
   // In the editor's copy: sprotty measures shapes in a hidden one on the page.
   await expect(page.locator('.sprotty:not(.sprotty-hidden) .sprotty-node')).toHaveCount(2);

   // The data head reads the open file, with focus in the Explorer beside it.
   await page.locator('.theia-FileTree .theia-TreeNode', { hasText: 'nodes.bookstore' }).click();
   await expect(page.locator('.theia-FileTree:focus-within')).toHaveCount(1);
   await runCommand(page, 'Bookstore: Show Model');
   // `first()`: Theia lists a notification in its toast and in the notification centre.
   await expect(
      page.locator('.theia-notification-message').filter({ hasText: 'nodes.bookstore holds a BookstoreModel' }).first()
   ).toBeVisible();

   // Then as text, through the Explorer's Open With.
   await page.locator('.theia-FileTree .theia-TreeNode', { hasText: 'nodes.bookstore' }).click({ button: 'right' });
   await page.locator('.lm-Menu-item', { hasText: 'Open With...' }).click();
   await page.locator('.quick-input-list .monaco-list-row', { hasText: 'Text Editor' }).click();
   const editor = page.locator('.monaco-editor .view-lines').first();
   await expect(editor).toContainText('node First');
   await editor.click();
   await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+End');
   // In one edit: typed key by key, the half-typed reference is reported on the way.
   await page.keyboard.insertText('\nnode Broken -> Missing');
   await expect(page.locator('.monaco-editor .squiggly-error').first()).toBeVisible();
});

/** Open `file` through Quick Open, so it gets the editor a user would. */
async function quickOpen(page: Page, file: string): Promise<void> {
   await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+P');
   const input = page.locator('.quick-input-widget input');
   await input.fill(file);
   await expect(page.locator('.quick-input-list .monaco-list-row').first()).toContainText(file);
   await input.press('Enter');
   await expect(page.locator('.quick-input-widget')).toBeHidden();
}

/** Run the command whose palette entry reads `label`, checked before Enter, since the match is fuzzy. */
async function runCommand(page: Page, label: string): Promise<void> {
   await page.keyboard.press('F1');
   const input = page.locator('.quick-input-widget input');
   await input.fill(`>${label}`);
   await expect(page.locator('.quick-input-list .monaco-list-row.focused')).toContainText(label);
   await input.press('Enter');
   await expect(page.locator('.quick-input-widget')).toBeHidden();
}

==============================================================================
host-theia-electron/README.md
==============================================================================
# bookstore-host-theia-electron

Bookstore in a Theia Electron application: the Theia extension in `../theia`,
and `../vscode-servers` sideloaded through `@theia/plugin-ext`, which starts the
server and its language client. Electron runs the window, and a backend process
it starts runs the server. The servers extension contributes no editor, so a
diagram file opens in the Theia diagram editor alone.

```bash
npm run build      # bundle and type-check, and download Electron; build the members first
npm run watch      # rebundle whenever the members’ builds change; reload the window to pick it up
npm start          # the application on ../workspace
npm run test:e2e   # the smoke test, which launches the application itself
```

There is no `theia rebuild:electron` step: Theia’s native modules are N-API
builds, which load in Electron as `npm install` built them for Node.

`npm run watch` reports a `theia-source-map-paths` JSON error as it starts:
`esbuild.mjs` starts the browser and electron builds together, and they share
`lib/frontend`. Later rebuilds are clean.

## Layout

- `esbuild.mjs` — the bundling `theia build` runs. It keeps this file, so it is the place to adjust the bundle
- `start.mjs` — `npm start`: links `../vscode-servers` into `plugins/`, then starts the application on a folder given as its argument or `../workspace`
- `playwright.config.mts` — the smoke tier
- `test/smoke.spec.mts` — Electron opens a copy of the workspace with a profile of its own, and each head answers

==============================================================================
host-theia-electron/esbuild.mjs
==============================================================================
/**
 * This file can be edited to adjust the ESBuild build process.
 * To reset, delete this file and rerun theia build again.
 */
import { browserOptions, watch } from './gen-esbuild.browser.mjs';
import { nodeOptions } from './gen-esbuild.node.mjs';
import { electronOptions } from './gen-esbuild.electron.mjs';
import esbuild from 'esbuild';

const browserContext = await esbuild.context(browserOptions);
const nodeContext = await esbuild.context(nodeOptions);
const electronContext = await esbuild.context(electronOptions);

if (watch) {
   await Promise.all([browserContext.watch(), nodeContext.watch(), electronContext.watch()]);
} else {
   try {
      await browserContext.rebuild();
      await browserContext.dispose();
      await nodeContext.rebuild();
      await nodeContext.dispose();
      await electronContext.rebuild();
      await electronContext.dispose();
   } catch {
      process.exit(1);
   }
}

==============================================================================
host-theia-electron/start.mjs
==============================================================================
// `npm start`: the Theia desktop application on the folder given as the
// argument, `../workspace` when there is none.

import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

// Paths from this file, not the working directory, which a direct `node` run can set anywhere.
const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const link = path.join(here, 'plugins', 'bookstore-vscode-servers');

// The servers extension, sideloaded from plugins/ beside any other plugin there.
// Linked here rather than in the build, which a build cache can replay without
// it; replaced every time, since a dangling link left by a moved extension
// fails `symlinkSync`.
fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(link), { recursive: true });
const existing = fs.lstatSync(link, { throwIfNoEntry: false });
// A link, a junction included, is unlinked, never handed to a recursive remove
// that might reach `../vscode-servers` through it.
if (existing?.isSymbolicLink()) {
   fs.unlinkSync(link);
} else {
   fs.rmSync(link, { recursive: true, force: true });
}
fs.symlinkSync(path.join(here, '../vscode-servers'), link, 'junction');

const workspace = path.resolve(process.argv[2] ?? path.join(here, '../workspace'));
// The CLI run by this Node, with no shell: the workspace path reaches Theia as it is.
// `local-dir:` relative to `cwd`, since Theia reads an absolute path as a URI.
const cli = createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve('@theia/cli/bin/theia.js');
const theia = spawn(process.execPath, [cli, 'start', '--plugins=local-dir:./plugins', workspace], {
   cwd: here,
   stdio: 'inherit'
});
for (const signal of ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM']) {
   process.on(signal, () => theia.kill(signal));
}
theia.on('exit', (code, signal) => {
   if (signal === null) {
      process.exit(code ?? 1);
   }
   // Ended by a signal, so end by it too: Ctrl+C is a stop, not a failure.
   process.removeAllListeners(signal);
   process.kill(process.pid, signal);
});

// The smoke tier: the test launches the application in Electron itself, so
// there is no server to start here. It runs what `npm run build` bundled, so
// build first.

import { defineConfig } from '@playwright/test';

export default defineConfig({
   testDir: './test',
   // The first window waits for the backend to start the server and build the workspace.
   timeout: 120_000,
   expect: { timeout: 60_000 }
});

==============================================================================
host-theia-electron/test/smoke.spec.mts
==============================================================================
// Theia opens a copy of the starter workspace with this application's
// extensions, the diagram file draws in its diagram editor, the data head reads
// the file, and the server reports a reference that resolves to nothing.

import { expect, test as base, type ElectronApplication, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { once } from 'node:events';
import { cpSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync, symlinkSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

/**
 * The application in Electron, on a copy of the starter workspace, since the
 * server writes its repairs to the folder it opens, with a profile of its own:
 * Theia quits at once while another window holds one. Its settings are its own
 * too, so a run never writes `~/.theia/settings.json`.
 */
const test = base.extend<{ page: Page }>({
   page: async ({ playwright }, use) => {
      const scratch = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'bookstore-theia-electron-'));
      const workspace = join(scratch, 'workspace');
      // The servers extension, sideloaded from a plugins folder as `npm start` does.
      const plugins = join(scratch, 'plugins');
      const link = join(plugins, 'bookstore-vscode-servers');
      let app: ElectronApplication | undefined;
      try {
         cpSync(fileURLToPath(new URL('../../workspace', import.meta.url)), workspace, { recursive: true });
         mkdirSync(plugins);
         symlinkSync(fileURLToPath(new URL('../../vscode-servers', import.meta.url)), link, 'junction');
         // Playwright resolves Electron itself; given its path, Theia opens this
         // folder instead of the workspace.
         app = await playwright._electron.launch({
            args: [
               fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url)),
               '--no-sandbox',
               `--user-data-dir=${join(scratch, 'user-data')}`,
               // In URI form, since Theia reads the argument as a URI.
               `--plugins=local-dir:${pathToFileURL(plugins).pathname}`,
               workspace
            ],
            env: {
               ...process.env,
               THEIA_CONFIG_DIR: join(scratch, 'config'),
               // Menus drawn in the page, where the test can click them.
               THEIA_ELECTRON_DISABLE_NATIVE_ELEMENTS: '1'
            }
         });
         await use(await app.firstWindow());
      } finally {
         try {
            // Exited, not closed: closing asks whether to save the edited file. An
            // app that is already gone is left alone, so the test's own error stands.
            const child = app?.process();
            if (app && child?.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null) {
               const exited = once(child, 'exit');
               await app.evaluate(({ app: electron }) => electron.exit(0));
               await exited;
            }
         } finally {
            // Unlinked first, so the remove never reaches `../vscode-servers` through it.
            rmSync(link, { force: true });
            rmSync(scratch, { recursive: true, force: true });
         }
      }
   }
});

test('draws the diagram, reads the model, and reports a broken reference', async ({ page }) => {
   // Up once the loading screen is gone; a key pressed before then is lost.
   await expect(page.locator('.theia-preload')).toHaveCount(0);
   await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+Shift+E');
   await expect(page.locator('.theia-FileTree .theia-TreeNode', { hasText: 'nodes.bookstore' })).toBeVisible();
   await quickOpen(page, 'nodes.bookstore');

   // The diagram file opens in its diagram, which draws the two starter nodes.
   // In the editor's copy: sprotty measures shapes in a hidden one on the page.
   await expect(page.locator('.sprotty:not(.sprotty-hidden) .sprotty-node')).toHaveCount(2);

   // The data head reads the open file, with focus in the Explorer beside it.
   await page.locator('.theia-FileTree .theia-TreeNode', { hasText: 'nodes.bookstore' }).click();
   await expect(page.locator('.theia-FileTree:focus-within')).toHaveCount(1);
   await runCommand(page, 'Bookstore: Show Model');
   // `first()`: Theia lists a notification in its toast and in the notification centre.
   await expect(
      page.locator('.theia-notification-message').filter({ hasText: 'nodes.bookstore holds a BookstoreModel' }).first()
   ).toBeVisible();

   // Then as text, through the Explorer's Open With.
   await page.locator('.theia-FileTree .theia-TreeNode', { hasText: 'nodes.bookstore' }).click({ button: 'right' });
   await page.locator('.lm-Menu-item', { hasText: 'Open With...' }).click();
   await page.locator('.quick-input-list .monaco-list-row', { hasText: 'Text Editor' }).click();
   const editor = page.locator('.monaco-editor .view-lines').first();
   await expect(editor).toContainText('node First');
   await editor.click();
   await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+End');
   // In one edit: typed key by key, the half-typed reference is reported on the way.
   await page.keyboard.insertText('\nnode Broken -> Missing');
   await expect(page.locator('.monaco-editor .squiggly-error').first()).toBeVisible();
});

/** Open `file` through Quick Open, so it gets the editor a user would. */
async function quickOpen(page: Page, file: string): Promise<void> {
   await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+P');
   const input = page.locator('.quick-input-widget input');
   await input.fill(file);
   await expect(page.locator('.quick-input-list .monaco-list-row').first()).toContainText(file);
   await input.press('Enter');
   await expect(page.locator('.quick-input-widget')).toBeHidden();
}

/** Run the command whose palette entry reads `label`, checked before Enter, since the match is fuzzy. */
async function runCommand(page: Page, label: string): Promise<void> {
   await page.keyboard.press('F1');
   const input = page.locator('.quick-input-widget input');
   await input.fill(`>${label}`);
   await expect(page.locator('.quick-input-list .monaco-list-row.focused')).toContainText(label);
   await input.press('Enter');
   await expect(page.locator('.quick-input-widget')).toBeHidden();
}
